# sf-deck v0.1.10

Security and dependency maintenance release.

## Security

- Build with Go 1.26.10 and updated networking dependencies, including fixes
  for HTTP and certificate handling.
- Update Excelize to 2.11.1, fixing malformed-workbook panics, excessive memory
  allocation, and CPU exhaustion in XLSX report processing.

## Updates

- Bubble Tea 2.1.0, ANSI handling 0.11.9, and SQLite 1.60.1.
- Updated documentation theme, certificate bundle, and pinned build actions.

## Upgrading

```sh
brew update
brew upgrade --cask sf-deck
```

Linux users can install the matching `.deb` or `.rpm` package from this release,
or replace their portable binary using the archive for their architecture.

macOS binaries remain unsigned unless Apple signing credentials are configured.
